action.objective: Verify e3d4 (bishop captures d4 pawn) as the reserved suggestion, checking whether Black recaptures with Qxd4 and White's follow-up.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 gives e3d4 the top exact score of +2 with PV e3d4 Qxd4 e2e3, but d4 recapture by the queen needs deeper verification. The line Qxd4 e2e3 may allow ...Qxe3+ or Qd8xd4 wins a tempo. Need to confirm White isn't simply losing the bishop for a pawn. Single-candidate verification with the reserved 2000 nodes.
